official_definition: Horoscoping (Timing) You can reveal a card from the top of your deck. If it's a "Galaxian" family card, add it to your Hand. Otherwise, return it to the bottom of your deck. When you added it to your Hand, [effect].

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Horoscoping] or [Horoscoping: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Horoscoping]", "give [Horoscoping]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
